conversations.title: Booking a room for a client meeting

lines.text: Is the meeting room free at ten o'clock tomorrow?

lines.text: Let me check. Yes, it's free. For how many people do you need it?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: For five people. Does the room have a projector?
lines.text_cz: Pro pět lidí. Má ta místnost projektor?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, it does. I'll reserve it for you until noon.
lines.text_cz: Ano, má. Zarezervuji ji pro vás do poledne.
